ConversionReadiness.Summary: 3BA currently fits the experimental/manual-cleanup tier: conversion can proceed=False, physics-ready=True, safe-animation=False, skeleton reliability=provisional, remap safety=unsafe, target-body support=direct.

Caveats: Radically different topology can still need manual Outfit Studio cleanup before release.
Extreme oral/genital/alien/custom appendage meshes remain the highest-risk automatic conversion path.
Generated validation guidance improves review for 3BA, but it is not a substitute for real in-game/runtime checks.

LimitationNotes: Topology matching still relies on heuristic island, boundary, and regional correspondence rather than full authored semantic vertex correspondence.
Source and target topology diverged enough that automatic correspondence should be treated as advisory only.
Heuristic-heavy correspondence means radically different meshes still need manual Outfit Studio review before release.
No authored semantic anchor profile was available for this target body, so true landmark-backed correspondence is still unavailable.
Recommendations: Open preview-workbench.html and morphs.json, then compare arms, belly, breasts, butt against the converted mesh before trusting automatic correspondence.
Plan an Outfit Studio cleanup pass or closer source-body selection when radically different mesh semantics cannot be matched automatically.
Treat the reported topology correspondence as review guidance, not proof of true semantic mesh alignment.
